newsitem.title: CANADA: Falconbridge signs C$50 mln open pit deal.
newsitem.headline: Falconbridge signs C$50 mln open pit deal.

text.p: Falconbridge Ltd has awarded a C$50-million contract to a Montreal construction company and a native Inuit group to help with open pit nickel and copper mining at its Raglan property.
Falconbridge signed the deal Friday with Les Entreprises Kiewit Ltd and Nuvumiut Development Inc to extract nickel from the northern Quebec mine starting next year.
"This gets us further down the road, it keeps us on track," said Falconbridge spokeswoman Caroline Casselman.
The open pit mine at Raglan is only a small part of the plan to develop the property, she said.
The contract, which runs until 2004, will create about 40 permanent jobs in an area of high youth unemployment, the Inuit group said.
The contract marks the first time Quebec Inuit have been accepted as partners in a mining development, they said.
